unit: metres above the sphere of 1737.4 km
order: row by row; row 0 is y max, column 0 is x min: the pixel grid of illumination.png
projection: south polar stereographic, sphere 1737.4 km, true scale at the pole: rho = 2R*tan((90+lat)/2), x = rho*sin(lon) (towards 90 E), y = rho*cos(lon) (towards 0 E); image row 0 is y max, column 0 is x min
source: NASA LOLA elevation model LDEM_75S_120M (PDS LOLA GDR), 120 m pixels averaged to 240 m
